cards.name: Cleave
cards.offered: Rest stops (camp, shop, tavern), 2 shown per pick; only if owner is alive
cards.hit_effect: Knight hits one extra front enemy (2 → 3 targets).
cards.knightTargets: What I want Cleave to do is this. I want diminishing returns in the game so if a knight strikes, he does 100% damage on the first and 50% damage on the second enemy. Upgrading cleave will increase the amount of damage you do on the second enemy to 65% 75% 85% 95% then it will start damaging the third enemy as well.
cards.levelCost_knight: Moves the crit down on the meter so it gets a little harder to get crits
cards.combos: Forge (with Embers) – proposed, not in code

cards.name: Swing and a Miss
cards.offered: Rest stops (camp, shop, tavern), 2 shown per pick; only if owner is alive
cards.hit_effect: Increases the actual damage the Knight does
cards.miss_or_cost: If you miss the momentum of the strike will hit the person behind you for a quarter of their life. The negative is a one off, but the actual damage can be upgraded.

cards.name: Embers
cards.offered: Rest stops (camp, shop, tavern), 2 shown per pick; only if owner is alive
cards.miss_or_cost: Has a 5% chance to do friendly fire on a miss, Increase by 5% for each upgrade.
cards.combos: Forge (with Cleave); Wildfire (with Inferno) – proposed, not in code

cards.name: Shield Wall
cards.offered: Rest stops (camp, shop, tavern), 2 shown per pick
cards.hit_effect: The first attack an enemy does has 50% chans of being blocked once a combat. Upgrade it 5 times turns it into 100% block chance on the very first attack the enemy does. Pretty good vs bosses.
cards.miss_or_cost: Moves the block meter back a little bit, must be countered with buying better armor.

cards.name: Storm Surge
cards.offered: Rest stops (camp, shop, tavern), 2 shown per pick; only if owner is alive
cards.hit_effect: Right answer: lightning hits every enemy harder (+3).

cards.name: Overcharge
cards.offered: Rest stops (camp, shop, tavern), 2 shown per pick; only if owner is alive
cards.hit_effect: Right answer: lightning hits every enemy much harder (+6).
cards.miss_or_cost: A miss shocks one ally (1 heart unit, never the last).

cards.name: Rallying Cry
cards.hit_effect: There is a 5% chans your party will strike again.
cards.miss_or_cost: This will anger your foes so there is also a 5% chans that enemies will strike directly when the meter goes to zero instead of waiting. The idea is just that if you are good you will be rewarded.
